name: clause_list_join
description: Structurally different but behaviorally equivalent correct implementation: build() assembles a list of already-formatted clause strings ("SELECT ...", optionally "WHERE ...", optionally "LIMIT ...") and joins the list with a single space at the end, instead of incrementally concatenating (+=) onto a running sql string. Same clause order, same comma/AND separators, same omission rules -- different control flow/data structure.
